svg.title: Manual Journals and Close — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN process across Journal Preparer, Journal Approver, and Finance or Controller lanes. Reporting-period activity leads to journal preparation, approval, and posting; an exclusive year-end decision either ends the period activity or records annual closing entries.

div.div:
JournalEntry is the header; GLEntry holds posted detail. The model does not invent a journal-line table, a close checklist, or a period-lock system.
Independent reconciliation / segregation-of-duties review is a proposed control. Accrued-service settlement has its own supplier-invoice model.
